audit.whatIsWrong: Five chart rows read Ornn or Skill while the content layer's whys for those same rows describe Lillia winning them outright ('this becomes your lane', 'your takeover', 'your hardest punish', 'he never reclaims the duel').
audit.why: Ornn has no dash and no ranged threat outside Volcanic Rupture's 800-range line; Lillia's stacking Move Speed plus the Dream Dust DoT scale against exactly the armour and HP he buys. His only spike is Level 6 point-blank engage, which her sleep pre-empts.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Skill / Lillia / Lillia / Lillia / Lillia / Lillia / Lillia with ratings 5, 6, 6, 7, 7, 7, 6, proposed as matched full+content pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags that the page never names Ornn's abilities, and the level-chart whys were generic Lillia boilerplate that never stated the one combo that kills her.
audit.why: Bellows Breath applies Brittle on the final gout of flame; Searing Charge only knocks up when Ornn collides with terrain, and Call of the Forge God's elemental knocks up again on the recast. That is the whole kill chain, and it is point-blank — which is precisely why her sleep on the wind-up defuses it.
audit.corrected: Bellows Breath, Searing Charge and Brittle written into the chart whys and the Don't line; Level 6 why now states the pre-sleep.

audit.whatIsWrong: A Don't line told the player to stop respecting 'a kill threat he doesn't have'.
audit.why: Ornn absolutely has a kill threat — it is just point-blank and telegraphed. Telling a Lillia he has none invites the one death this lane offers.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to 'Trade while standing still beside him', with the Brittle-into-charge chain as the reason.

edits.before: Q's outer ring on his last-hits plus the passive speed means he literally cannot touch you at level 1.
edits.after: Neither of you has a kit at 1 — farm at Q's outer edge and refuse the Brittle-auto trade he wants.

edits.before: W sweetspot threat starts — anyone chasing you eats the big hit while your Dream Dust burns their HP bar.
edits.after: Q sweetspot plus Swirlseed slow start the burn, and your speed keeps you clear of a dashless Ornn.

edits.before: Full kit: Q-kite in circles, E from fog for the slow, and the passive speed makes every trade yours to end.
edits.after: Layered Q sweetspots and the compounding DoT chip his huge HP bar while you stay outside Searing Charge.

edits.before: The lane is a treadmill he can't get off — Q every step-up, kite the Volcanic Rupture window, and bank Dream Dust burn.
edits.after: Full-rank Q poke and the Dream Dust burn grind down a tank who must walk at the wave and cannot out-chip you.

edits.before: Lilting Lullaby online — your jungler's ganks are now guaranteed, and any overstep becomes a sleep-execute.
edits.after: Lilting Lullaby sleeps his Searing Charge or R wind-up and blanks ganks — his only answer is point-blank CC.

edits.before: Liandry's spike — Dream Dust plus the burn melts juggernauts and tanks alike while you jog circles around them.
edits.after: Liandry's makes your W and Dream Dust deal percent-HP damage that scales UP as he itemizes tanky — your hardest punish.

edits.before: You're a teamfight nightmare now: sleep two, kite the rest, and let the burn do the bookkeeping.
edits.after: He never reclaims the duel — your DoT punishes every point of HP he buys; respect the R knockups.

edits.before: Burn-tank paradise — Dream Dust eats %HP and he has no way to stop the jog.
edits.after: Burn-tank paradise — but Bellows Breath into Searing Charge still kills you.

edits.before: Burn-tank paradise — Dream Dust eats %HP and he has no way to stop the jog.
edits.after: Burn-tank paradise — but Bellows Breath into Searing Charge still kills you.

edits.before: Respect a kill threat he doesn't have
edits.after: Trade while standing still beside him

edits.before: That’s Ornn’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: Bellows Breath makes you Brittle, then Searing Charge knocks you into it.

notes: The packet-flagged suspect name 'Use Lilting Lullaby' is a false positive — correct Riot name. The full layer's diff enum still reads EVEN while its own breakdown says 'Favoured matchup — difficulty 4/10'; I left the enum alone rather than guess at the allowed token set, but it is worth a sweep. Searing Charge only knocks up on terrain collision — worth remembering that hugging open ground denies the knockup entirely, though I left that for a prose slot with room.
